description: This file defines the 'BannerSStyle5' widget, a specific style implementation of a banner component in Flutter. It assembles a UI element with background image, optional subtitle, title, optional bottom text, and an SVG icon, leveraging a shared 'BannerS' component.

classes.name: BannerSStyle5
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a styled banner with customizable image, title, subtitle, bottom text, and an onPress callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the banner, composing text, image, and styling elements.
